Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Gauntlet · uses training: Refresh describes Gauntlet 4K-RLVR as a curated 4,000-task subset of Gauntlet packaged with prompts, tests and preconfigured Docker environments for Harbor, using pytest-based binary rewards for reinforcement learning.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gauntlet.4k-rlvr-subset.v2

  • The 4K subset/configuration remains part of the existing Gauntlet family and does not inherit any universal runtime or training-performance guarantee.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Gauntlet · dataset size: Refresh’s Gauntlet 80K article describes 79,139 software-engineering tasks drawn from developer workflows across 1,669 Python repositories using runtime tracing to pair task descriptions with code changes.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal12.gauntlet.capture-units.v2

  • These are creator-reported task/repository units, not independently recounted payload totals or evidence of a named external supplier.
  • The 80K label is a rounded release name.

Gauntlet · benchmark task: Refresh describes Gauntlet tasks as including complete repositories with Git history and pre-resolved dependencies in Docker environments, rather than only static prompt-and-patch records.
